recoveryCodes.title: Save your recovery codes
recoveryCodes.subtitle: If you lose your phone, you can sign in with one of these codes. Each code works once, and we won't show them again.
recoveryCodes.copyFailed: We couldn't copy them. Select the codes and copy them yourself.
recoveryCodes.fileBody: Each code works once. Keep this file somewhere safe and don't share it with anyone.
recoveryCodes.extraBody: An authenticator app on your phone
recoveryCodes.totpIntro: Add this key to your authenticator app, then type the 6-digit code it shows.
recoveryCodes.totpEnabled: Authenticator app turned on. We'll ask for its code when you sign in.
recoveryCodes.savedCheck: I've saved the codes somewhere safe
recoveryCodes.mustConfirm: Confirm you've saved the codes to continue.
recoveryCodes.missingTitle: The codes are no longer shown here
recoveryCodes.missingBody: For your safety, recovery codes are shown only once. If you didn't save them, create new ones now; the old codes will stop working.
